title: MLH student hackathons
summary: The official student hackathon league. Hundreds of weekend events, many with AI tracks and sponsor prizes.

title: Devpost hackathons
summary: The biggest hackathon directory. Filter for AI and machine learning themes and online events.

title: lablab.ai AI hackathons
summary: Short online hackathons built around new AI models and APIs. A fast way to ship an LLM project with a team.

title: TreeHacks
summary: Stanford's flagship hackathon, with heavy AI sponsor presence.

title: HackMIT
summary: MIT's undergraduate hackathon, one of the most selective in the US.

title: Cal Hacks
summary: One of the world's largest collegiate hackathons, run by Berkeley students.

title: PennApps
summary: The original college hackathon.

title: Kaggle competitions
summary: The standard place to prove ML skill on real data. A top-10% finish is a strong resume line.

title: DrivenData competitions
summary: Data science competitions on social-impact problems.

title: AIcrowd challenges
summary: Research-grade challenges, often tied to NeurIPS and other conferences.

title: Zindi competitions
summary: Africa's largest data science community, open to everyone.

title: ICPC programming contest
summary: The world's oldest college programming contest. Quant firms and big tech recruit heavily from it.

title: Jane Street programs and events
timing: Applications open each fall and winter
summary: Short paid programs for students curious about trading and quantitative research. A known pipeline to internships.

title: Jane Street monthly puzzle
summary: Monthly math puzzles. Solvers are listed on the page, which recruiters notice.

title: Google Summer of Code
summary: Get paid to work on open-source projects over the summer, including many ML libraries.

title: Outreachy internships
summary: Paid remote open-source internships.

title: MLH Fellowship
summary: A remote internship alternative: contribute to open source with a pod of peers and a mentor.

title: Google PhD Fellowship
summary: Funding and a Google research mentor for PhD students in computing.

title: NVIDIA Graduate Fellowship
summary: Funding for PhD research in GPU computing, AI, robotics and graphics, plus an NVIDIA internship.

title: Microsoft Research PhD Fellowship
summary: Two years of funding and an invitation to intern at Microsoft Research.

title: Meta Research PhD Fellowship
summary: Funding for PhD students in AI, systems and related fields.

title: Apple Scholars in AI/ML
summary: Recognizes emerging leaders in AI and ML research.

title: NSF Graduate Research Fellowship
who: Seniors and early grad students (US citizens and permanent residents)
summary: The best-known US fellowship for graduate research in science and engineering.

title: Hertz Fellowship
amount: Up to five years of funding
summary: One of the most prestigious PhD fellowships in applied science.

title: Knight-Hennessy Scholars
summary: Full funding for any Stanford graduate degree, open to international students.

title: MATS (ML Alignment & Theory Scholars)
summary: Mentored research program in AI alignment and safety with researchers from top labs.

title: AI Safety Camp
summary: Remote research teams that work on AI safety projects for a few months.

title: Thiel Fellowship
summary: A two-year grant to build something instead of sitting in a classroom.

title: Emergent Ventures
summary: Quick grants for talented people, with a short application and answers in weeks.

title: Y Combinator
summary: The best-known startup accelerator. Most recent batches are majority AI companies.

title: a16z speedrun
summary: a16z's accelerator for very early teams.

title: Neo Scholars and Neo Accelerator
summary: Mentorship and funding for top student engineers, plus an accelerator for founders.

title: Z Fellows
summary: A one-week fellowship and a small check to start building.

title: AI Grant
summary: Accelerator for AI-native products, backed by well-known AI investors.

title: PearX
summary: Pre-seed accelerator with deep university ties.

title: South Park Commons
summary: A community and fund for people exploring what to build next.

title: Entrepreneur First
where: London, San Francisco, Bangalore and more
summary: Meet a co-founder and start a company from scratch.

title: Techstars
summary: Global network of accelerators, many with an AI focus.

title: TPU Research Cloud
summary: Free Cloud TPU time for open research.

title: NVIDIA Inception
summary: Free program for AI startups: technical help, discounts and investor intros.

title: AWS Activate
summary: AWS credits and support for early startups.

title: Google for Startups Cloud Program
summary: Google Cloud credits, with extra for AI-first startups.

title: Microsoft for Startups
summary: Azure credits and tools for early-stage founders.
